Arisa Shida (Japanese: 志田有彩 Shida Arisa) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Shida was born on October 3rd, in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan and became a voice actor as an adult. Shida joined the during , voicing Onia from the Explorers.
